title: cupania mayana
intro: Cupania mayana, commonly known as the Mayan plum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cupania mayana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. Additionally, it is also used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its leaves are used as a natural remedy for wounds and skin conditions.
